answers.question: how is the shortfall funded?
answers.answer: Only partially answerable: the prospectus shows the company maintains margins to secure performance bank guarantees and warns it may fail to fund those margins, shortfalls could prevent it from obtaining new PBGs [business, page 212], and rising guarantee amounts (~₹745m at FY26) are disclosed additionally [promoters, page 329] / [related_party, page 381]. Conversely, an order book value far below annual revenue would push the long-term score lower.
